question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as core/plugin API and public config, or narrow this to smaller memory-core dreaming and diagnostics fixes?
rationale: The source-level limitation is real, but the proposed fix changes public config, plugin activation, per-agent overrides, and memory runtime ownership, which requires maintainer product/API intent rather than an automated repair branch.

options.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path and land it only if migration, docs, upgrade proof, and API compatibility are acceptable.

options.title: Narrow to targeted fixes
options.body: Keep the single memory slot for now and ask for smaller PRs around dreaming coexistence, disabled-plugin diagnostics, or documented workarounds.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Close the architecture direction and steer memory composition to external plugins or ClawHub until a missing core API is more narrowly defined.

recommendation.title: Review the linked role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical implementation path and land it only if migration, docs, upgrade proof, and API compatibility are acceptable.
